_comment: sim-robust-phase-timeout-during-recovery-v1 bounded GPU proof (hand-off to the integration lane, twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1). Purpose: prove a NAMED move_group crash recovery is no longer charged against the per-phase timeout, so (respawn2c) the respawn2b double-death collect now RECOVERS both deaths and completes carton-on-rollwagen, and (respawn3) the triple-death give-up proof becomes REACHABLE (it used to be blocked by the lift phase timing out before the 3rd death). Root cause (respawn2b host-stack.log + mission.json): the collect LIFT phase's 120 sim-s budget was spent ~119 s on two recovery cycles (TransferController.step counts self.elapsed += dt through every respawn + orphaned-goal wait + MOVE_DEADLINE_RETRY re-send), tripping HOST_FAULT_ESTOP phase=lift 'phase timeout: lift' on a crash that had otherwise recovered. The fix credits that recovery sim time out of the phase-timeout comparison (controller.step: elapsed - recovery_credit vs phase_timeout) while motion.crash_recovery_active() is True, bounded by RESTOCK_RECOVERY_PAUSE_CAP_S so a hung recovery still fails fast BY NAME. It is ALWAYS-ON + SELF-DISABLING (the credit accrues only while the adapter reports a crash recovery) so there is NO new mission config key and a no-crash run is byte-identical. The integration lane holds the GPU and schedules both runs through flock /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, never forced, never touching the whispr service (pid 1339, ~2.2 GB); do NOT edit the ~/datasets runtime configs from a worker PR -- this fragment is the hand-off.
_no_new_config_key: There is NO key to merge. The phase-clock credit lives in the controller (scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/controller.py step/_crash_recovery_active) and reads scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_adapter.py RosMotionPort.crash_recovery_active() (respawn hold / post-respawn re-attach / the new move_group liveness latch). It engages only while a crash recovery is in flight, so a healthy run never touches it. The ONLY config these runs need is the existing HOST movegroup_respawn block + the validator's own death injector (unchanged from respawn2b). An optional belt-and-braces env RESTOCK_RECOVERY_PAUSE_CAP_S (SIM seconds, default 300) bounds the credit; leave it at the default for both runs -- it is far above a real two/three-death recovery and the adapter's own bounds fail fast by name long before it.
_movegroup_respawn_note: Unchanged from respawn2b (HOST block, scripts/twin/restock_host/config.py / launch.py / movegroup_respawn.py). max_retries=2 => two lifetime respawns are allowed before the supervisor gives up by name.

_run_respawn2c_double_death_recovers_no_._setup: The respawn2b configuration UNCHANGED (head: this PR merged into fm/twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1): collect-only, FRESH commission, HOST movegroup_respawn={max_retries:2, delay:3.0}, the v3 injector killing move_group with kill -ABRT twice inside the collect LIFT (exactly as respawn2b).
_run_respawn2c_double_death_recovers_no_._command: scripts/run_restock_render_smoke.py ... (the validator's collect-only mission boot used for respawn2b) -- same runner, same guards (env_isaaclab python, the task-local nvidia userspace, flock /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, --heavy-threshold-mb 2500 for whispr), never --force.
_run_respawn2c_double_death_recovers_no_._pass_criteria: PASS = both deaths recover and collect COMPLETES with the carton on the rollwagen, with NO 'phase timeout' fault. The console shows, per death: 'MOVE_GROUP_RESPAWN move_group died pid=... exit=-6; relaunching move_group (attempt 1/2 ...)' then '... (attempt 2/2 ...)'; the lift phase survives both recoveries (one 'PHASE_CLOCK_RECOVERY_PAUSE phase=lift paused=...s sim' line names the total credited time); and the final state is collect succeeded (carton-on-rollwagen). FAIL = any 'HOST_FAULT_ESTOP phase=lift reason=...phase timeout: lift' (the respawn2b failure), 'arm command heartbeat lost', or the recovery-bound 'crash recovery exceeded its 300s sim pause budget ...' (would mean the recovery genuinely hung, not this fix misfiring).
_run_respawn2c_double_death_recovers_no_._what_changed_vs_respawn2b: respawn2b (pre-fix) failed collect attempt 1 at sim 149.87 with 'phase timeout: lift' -- the lift 120 s budget consumed ~119 s by the two recovery cycles. This run must instead PAUSE the lift clock across both recoveries (PHASE_CLOCK_RECOVERY_PAUSE) and finish collect. Note respawn2b's recovery flowed through the launch respawn + controller MOVE_DEADLINE_RETRY (NOT _awaiting_server_respawn), which is why the move_group liveness latch (not the crash-retry hold alone) is what arms crash_recovery_active() here.

_run_respawn3_triple_death_gives_up_by_n._setup: Identical to respawn2c but the v3 injector kills move_group a THIRD time (after the second recovery). movegroup_respawn stays {max_retries:2}.
_run_respawn3_triple_death_gives_up_by_n._pass_criteria: PASS = the first two deaths recover exactly as respawn2c (and the lift clock is paused across them, so NO phase timeout intervenes), then the THIRD death EXCEEDS max_retries so the respawn supervisor logs 'MOVE_GROUP_RESPAWN_GIVE_UP ...' naming 2/2 respawns used, NO fourth move_group pid is launched, and the stage FAILS FAST BY NAME (the PR 234/242 planner-unrecoverable / RESPAWN_WAIT_CAP_S 'did not respawn' fast-fail) BEFORE any 'phase timeout'. FAIL = a 4th move_group pid, a hang, a 'phase timeout: ...' fault, or an opaque (non-respawn-named) reason.
_run_respawn3_triple_death_gives_up_by_n._why_now_reachable: Pre-fix this proof was unreachable: the lift phase timed out during the FIRST or SECOND recovery before the 3rd death could even be injected. Pausing the phase clock across recovery lets the run reach the 3rd death and exercise the give-up + fast-fail backstop.
_run_respawn3_triple_death_gives_up_by_n._scope_note: This run only confirms the fix did NOT weaken the PR 247 bounded-respawn give-up or the PR 234/242 fast-fail backstop (both out of scope to change here, in scope to keep intact).

_activation_check: No HOST_EFFECTIVE_CONFIG key to grep (no new key). Confirm the fix path is reached by the 'PHASE_CLOCK_RECOVERY_PAUSE phase=lift paused=...s sim' line on each run with deaths; its absence on a no-death (healthy) run confirms self-disabling / byte-identical.
_cpu_proof: env -u PYTHONPATH PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python3 -m pytest scripts/twin/tests/test_restock_phase_timeout_recovery.py scripts/twin/tests/test_restock_detach_ack.py -- the two-recovery lift stays within budget with the pause; a hung recovery fails by name at the recovery bound; a no-recovery run has identical elapsed accounting and still times out by name; the move_group liveness latch arms crash_recovery_active() on a ready->not-ready transition; and the reconcile success path emits PAYLOAD_SYNC_DIAG gate=reconcile_detach_ok.
